description: Land Acquisition - Guruwela, Laggala-Pallegama D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It declares that specific parcels of land are needed for a public purpose and provides detailed descriptions of the land lots, including their extents, locations, and boundaries. The content is exclusively focused on land matters, specifically the acquisition of property by the state, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification.
